claim_boundary: Wave 52 accepts centered UET C only as a diagnostic finite-k proxy field. It does not accept source-equivalent field normalization because amplitude/variance normalization and ensemble/time-averaging convention remain blocked.

accepted_estimator_field_use.reason: The current package lacks a source-backed amplitude/variance normalization, ensemble-or-time averaging convention, and S(q) normalization mapping for exponent-bearing use.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: Wave 52 decides field-normalization readiness only; no estimator replacement, exponent rerun, universality, material, RG, or Tier A claim is accepted.

diagnostic_field_use.reason: Source formulas expose normalized concentration/order-parameter fluctuation language, and UET C can be centered to remove the conserved zero mode for finite-k S(q) diagnostics.

accepted_estimator_replacement_gate.required_condition: Do not accept the CH finite-k estimator for exponent use until source-equivalent field normalization passes.

missing: scale factor between UET C and source c_hat/delta c_hat
variance normalization or S(q) amplitude convention
material or nondimensional concentration basis beyond normalized proxy
amplitude_normalization_gate.required_condition: No source-backed amplitude or variance normalization maps UET C to the source fluctuation scale.

missing: seed aggregation rule for accepted estimator rows
averaging_convention_gate.required_condition: No accepted ensemble or time-averaging convention maps current snapshot fields to source S(q,t) use.

diagnostic_measurement_lane_gate.required_condition: Diagnostic finite-k S(q) inspection may continue with centered C as a proxy field.

exponent_rerun_gate.required_condition: Do not rerun exponent gates until accepted estimator replacement passes.

next_path_gate.required_condition: The next controller is amplitude/averaging normalization or explicit replacement observable policy.

source_equivalent_field_acceptance_gate.required_condition: Accepted estimator replacement requires amplitude normalization and averaging convention gates to pass.

source_field_symbol_gate.required_condition: Source fragments must expose normalized concentration/order-parameter fluctuation symbols relevant to S(q,t).

uet_centered_field_proxy_gate.required_condition: Centered UET C is acceptable as a diagnostic normalized fluctuation proxy after zero-mode removal.

wave51_chain_gate.required_condition: Wave 52 must start from Wave 51 with diagnostic lane pass and source-equivalent field normalization blocked.

limitations: No simulation or exponent verifier is rerun by this decision gate.
Centered UET C remains diagnostic-only for finite-k measurement.
Amplitude/variance normalization and ensemble/time-averaging convention are not source-accepted.
No estimator replacement, exponent, universality, material, RG, or Tier A claim may be upgraded.

uet_field_mapping_under_review.proposed_mapping: Use centered dimensionless UET order parameter as a diagnostic concentration-fluctuation field.
uet_field_mapping_under_review.source_symbol: delta c or normalized concentration fluctuation in S(q,t)

wave: Wave 52 CH finite-k field-normalization decision gate
